content.title: Money-moving POST endpoints (refunds, payouts, credits, charges) must honour the Idempotency-Key header
content.problem: POST /api/customers/:id/credits ignored Idempotency-Key, so a retried request issued a second credit and raised the balance twice.
symptoms: repeating a POST with the same Idempotency-Key header returned 201 with a new id instead of the original response
duplicate credit/refund/payout/charge created on client retry
content.component: HTTP POST endpoints that move money (credits)

steps: node --test test/idempotency.test.js (same key twice, expect same status+body and one credit row)

rootCause.explanation: Handler never read the Idempotency-Key header. Source: QA feedback, rule PAY-3: "Acme payments rule PAY-3: a POST endpoint that moves money (refunds, payouts, credits, charges) honours the Idempotency-Key request header. A repeated request with the same key returns the original status and body, and creates nothing new. A request without the header behaves normally."

failedAttempts.approach: Considered acme-kit memo() to cache the handler
failedAttempts.whyFailed: memo keys on the first argument only and caches per call rather than per successful outcome; ttlCache with an explicit scoped key fits.

solution.description: Read the Idempotency-Key header after body parsing and validation. Store successful responses (status+body) in a ttlCache keyed by endpoint|customer|key with a payload fingerprint (canonical JSON). Same key and payload: replay stored response, issue nothing. Same key, different payload: 422. Do not store failures. Keep lookup and store synchronous (or store an in-flight promise) so concurrent duplicates cannot both pass. No header: unchanged.
solution.tradeoffs: In-process store: lost on restart and not shared across instances; a shared store is needed for multi-instance. 24h TTL is a choice. Different-payload status 422 chosen to fit the acme-kit error table.

appliesWhen: Adding or changing any POST endpoint that moves money: refunds, payouts, credits, charges
QA or reviewers report duplicate money movement on retry
notApplicableWhen: POST endpoints that do not move money (e.g. profile or settings updates)
Endpoints whose repeated call is naturally idempotent (PUT/DELETE by id)

reviews.notes: Repro ev-muzhxkbc-01a3919f (node --test test/idempotency.test.js, exit 1, 5/8 fail) and fix ev-muzhxwhk-01a92f1d (same command, exit 0, 8/8) match; I re-ran it green (ev-muzhz0mr-0157da58) and npm test 42/42 (ev-muzhz0ai-01efed3b). Generic org rule PAY-3, no secrets or customer data.
